hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has two entries Lun Bawang [lnd] including the alternate name ``Lundaya Putuk'' and Putoh [put] with the remark that it ``may be the same as Lun Bawang [lnd]''. Both the name Putuk and the area marked on the map for Putuk, falls under the same language that the entry Lun Bawang [lnd] represents. Though this language has a lot of dialectal variation, the division indicated by the two Ethnologue entries is not justified from a linguistic or ethnic perspective
(**hh:e:Kaskija:Punan**:10-11, **hh:e:Crain:Lun-Dayeh**:17-35,
**hh:hv:Hudson:Sarawak**, **hh:hvs:Omar:Malay-Malaysia**:587-588, **hh:hv:Sellato:Kenyah-Putuk**). See also: Putoh [put].
